gap: The warm is a one-shot inside boot setup() and nothing on the gameplay path ever asks the bank for an item, so per-lesson loading covers exactly the first lesson of a page load: driving the shipped engine through 600 scored items over 19 sessions pulled ZERO additional group chunks beyond the 4 the boot warm and its prefetch had already fetched. Scheduler.serve() -- the only API that pairs a request with a bank item and reports source/relaxation -- has zero callers under app/; itemBank.select() appears in app/ only inside 62-learning.js:136's stale-bank-audit fallback; app/src/flow/Session.js drives scheduler.next() and never touches the bank. So touch(), generated-group-absent and the 30s retry -- claims B1/B2/C1/C2/C3, 6 of 22 -- run only inside P31.mjs's own harness. Separately, P31.mjs's five 'REAL built game' claims read a cached evidence file with no build-identity check: all 18 JS chunk names in P31-live-probe.json (index-XRRBCBzJ, ItemBank-Bkv3MSq0, 62-learning-hIc_9Lz7...) were absent from dist/assets, so it printed 22/22 PASS against a build that no longer existed. The byte win itself is real and independently reproduced: 548.0 -> 456.4 kB gz first load (-91.7, -16.7%).
